2317-2438-5478-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

339-677-4785-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-4785-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1385-4279-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-4279-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1978-5143-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
1978-5143-8190.description:
Cause Loot to become an artifact using Transmogrifying Licid.
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Loot.
Repeat from step 2.

687-2034-3334-8130.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
687-2034-3334-8130.description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Lae'zel), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Lae'zel.
Repeat.
687-2034-3334-8130.notes: This order of operations and the {2} starting mana are necessary because you cannot pay the counter removal cost before sacrificing the creature to Ashnod's Altar, due to the timing sequence of the activated ability rules.

3750-6758-7839.notablePrerequisites:
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
3750-6758-7839.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating 100 Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

372-4125-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4125-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6705-7297.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1329-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites: You have a nontoken artifact creature in your graveyard that can be cast using at most {C}{C}, with the mana to cast it.
1329-2034-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting the artifact creature in your graveyard.
Cast the artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.
1329-2034-2178.notes: You can get infinite mana if the creature only needs {C} or less mana to cast.

4002-4331-4985-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4985-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

630-647-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-647-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2511-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1077-5571-6797--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2173-2842-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

671-2173-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Blood Pet enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1987-4311-4423-5116.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus by tapping them, adding {3}{U}
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

67-997-2517-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-997-2517-5276.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

862-2459-3156-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crimson Kobolds.
862-2459-3156-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, targeting Rograkh.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Crimson Kobolds.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

643-2143-4434-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
643-2143-4434-4762.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When the Eldrazi Spawns enter the battlefield as Treefolk due to Maskwood Nexus, Quickbeam triggers twice, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +4/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

865-2034-2429.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten in any combination of Treasures and/or creatures.
865-2034-2429.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Mahadi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 2 until you control no creatures.
Resolve the Mahadi trigger from step 1, creating a Treasure token for each creature that died this turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.

1987-3075-3941-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-3075-3941-4125.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

2452-2577-3967.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2452-2577-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
